messages:
Rafael: heads up 1 publish pipeline red after today's typegen regen. sampleapp import fails during onboarding demo.
June: can you paste the main error?
Rafael: gist of the failing stack:
```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "demo/onboard.py", line 12, in <module>
    client.call_endpoint('/whoami')
TypeError: call_endpoint() takes 1 positional argument but 2 were given
```
Ling: looks like generated helper signature changed order of params. Did regen touch runtime helpers or just type metadata?
Rafael: regen diff shows only "parameter ordering normalization" in the changelog and it auto-bumped 0.4.2 -> 0.5.0.
Ava: if runtime wrappers changed we need a minor, otherwise patch. But auto-bump should not assume.
June: quick local check: `git show --name-only origin/regen-head` shows edits in `clients/python/runtime_helpers.py` 1 line swap. So runtime changed.
Ling: immediate plan: 1) revert runtime helper change (patch), 2) force-publish patch for python client to unblock sampleapp release, 3) add a one-line compatibility shim for one release cycle that accepts both arg orders and logs a deprecation.
Ava: agree. also we need follow-ups: regen should diff runtime artifacts (compiled stubs / generated py/ts runtime files) and classify diffs as "runtime-impacting" vs "types-only". If runtime-impacting then require manual approval for changelog bump > patch.
Rafael: i'll open the revert PR and include the shim + unit test for the overload guard in sdk-core. assigning to @June for review.
sdk-bot: Created DEVEX-3017: "regen: runtime-impact classification + manual approval gate" and linked PR #5011 (revert/shim).
June: for short-term CI: adding a pre-publish smoke job that pip installs the built wheel and runs `python -c 'import sampleapp; sampleapp.ping()'` against staging. If that fails, block publish. Will add PR after revert.
Ling: also recommend regen produce a human-readable summary: list of changed files, tags like [types-only] / [runtime-modified], suggested semver (patch/candidate-minor) and require an engineer sign-off for candidate-minor.
Ava: small UX win: when regen proposes changelog bump, include the git diff of generated runtime files inline in the PR body so reviewers can eyeball.
Rafael: +1. For the longer term, typegen should compute checksums of runtime templates and refuse to auto-minor if any runtime checksum changed.
June: CI note: build #5188 failed during publish/sampleapp. ci-bot: retry queued.
ci-bot: Re-run requested for build #5188 (queued).
Rafael: thanks all. i'll post PR links and the force-publish ticket once revert lands. Keeping this thread for status updates. :thumbsup:
